description:
This app helps users explore available deals on Groupon.com in a simple and structured way. Users can search by keyword or browse by category to discover offers and view key details such as price, discount, and a brief description in an easy-to-read format.
 
The app is designed to make it easier to browse, review, and compare deals. When a user selects a deal, they are redirected to Groupon.com to view full details and complete the purchase.
